results.title: Front-end Developer (React / Next.js)
results.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Front-end Developer (React / Next.js) based in Brazil.**

In this role, you will build and maintain high-quality, responsive user interfaces for innovative AI-powered video and image creation products. You will work with modern front-end technologies, including React, Next.js, and TypeScript, to deliver intuitive, dynamic, and high-performance digital experiences. Collaborating closely with designers and backend developers, you will transform Figma designs into polished interfaces while ensuring excellent usability, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility. You will also integrate backend APIs supporting advanced AI features, optimizing application performance and user interactions. Working within an established production codebase, you will contribute clean, maintainable code through structured development workflows and continuous testing. This is an exciting opportunity to join a remote, international team building cutting-edge creative technology for users worldwide.

### Accountabilities

- Develop, implement, and maintain dynamic, responsive user interfaces using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Build scalable front-end architectures using reusable components and libraries to ensure consistency, maintainability, and efficient development.
- Implement Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) strategies to optimize application performance and user experience.
- Translate Figma designs into accurate, pixel-perfect interfaces, paying close attention to layouts, spacing, interactions, and visual details.
- Ensure responsive design, accessibility standards (WCAG), and cross-browser compatibility across different devices and platforms.
- Integrate front-end applications with backend APIs supporting AI-powered features such as face swapping, lip synchronization, image editing, and video generation.
- Optimize application performance, manage application state effectively, and ensure smooth interactions across complex user workflows.
- Work within an existing production codebase, delivering clean, maintainable, and well-structured code.
- Implement unit and integration tests to ensure code reliability, functionality, and long-term maintainability.
- Manage development tasks through detailed tickets and submit focused, well-documented pull requests using GitHub and similar tools.
- Participate in Agile development practices, including daily stand-ups, code reviews, and team discussions.
- Collaborate closely with designers, backend developers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality product experiences.
- Proactively ask clarifying questions, identify potential challenges, and communicate progress effectively throughout the development process.

### Requirements:

- At least 3 years of professional experience in front-end development or software engineering.
- Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Solid understanding of modern front-end development principles, component-based architectures, and reusable UI patterns.
- Practical experience implementing SSR and SSG strategies using Next.js.
- Strong understanding of responsive web design, accessibility standards, UI performance, and cross-browser compatibility.
- Experience integrating REST APIs or similar backend services into front-end applications.
- Good product sense, with a strong eye for detail and a commitment to delivering polished, intuitive user experiences.
- Ability to translate Figma designs into accurate, production-ready interfaces.
- Familiarity with development and collaboration tools such as Figma, GitHub, Slack, and Linear or equivalent platforms.
- Experience with version control, code reviews, testing, and structured development workflows.
- Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken, with the ability to collaborate effectively within an international team.
- Proactive problem-solving mindset, including the ability to ask relevant questions, clarify requirements, and anticipate potential implementation challenges.
- Reliable availability during Americas working hours, with sufficient overlap with Pacific Standard Time (PST).
- Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and consistently deliver high-quality results in a remote environment.

- Experience working in startups or fast-growing technology companies.
- Familiarity with AI-powered applications, creative tools, or video and image processing platforms.

results.title: Web Developer (Next.js) – Work from Home | Hampox
results.description:
Hampox builds websites and online stores for growing businesses across India. We're looking for a developer who cares about design, someone who builds websites that look beautiful and work flawlessly, and can take a project from first screen to live deployment.

What you'll do

- Build online stores using our e-commerce template, customised to each client's brand.
- Design and build business websites from scratch: landing pages, company sites and product catalogues.
- Add animations, smooth scrolling effects and polished details that make each site feel premium.
- Connect payments (Razorpay), shipping (Shiprocket), WhatsApp buttons, enquiry forms and Google Maps.
- Deploy every project yourself on Cloudflare or Vercel, connect the client's domain, and hand it over ready to use.
- Make every site fast, mobile-friendly and set up with basic SEO.

What we're looking for

- Strong skills in Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
- A good eye for design: spacing, typography, colour and animation.
- Experience deploying websites and connecting domains.
- Comfortable working independently and meeting deadlines.
- A portfolio of live websites you've built. This matters more than your degree.
- Freshers with a strong portfolio are welcome.

What we offer

- ₹15,000+ per month, work from home.
- Real client projects across e-commerce, real estate, travel and more.
- Templates and guidance from the founder on larger projects.

You must have hands-on experience with:

- E-commerce: product catalogues with variants (size, colour, stock per variant), cart, checkout, order flow and an admin panel.
- Payments: a Razorpay or Stripe integration, including payment verification on the server and webhooks. A frontend payment button isn't enough.
- Databases: designing tables for products, orders and customers (SQL, or D1, Postgres or MongoDB).
- Backend logic: API routes, form handling, email sending, and protecting admin pages with login.
- Third-party integrations: shipping APIs (Shiprocket or similar), WhatsApp links, Google Maps, Google Analytics.
- Deployment: Cloudflare or Vercel, environment variables, domains and DNS.
- Performance and SEO: image optimisation, meta tags, sitemaps, structured data.

<!--THE END-->

Your portfolio must include at least one working online store or custom web app where you built the checkout or the backend yourself.
